text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: There's no reply from "Pace Reader"-san...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All the sticky notes we wrote replies on 
were ripped off, nodda. What awful jerks, 
nodda! 
...As expected of fellow bad guys, nodda.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So communicating through graffiti was a 
bust, huh... 
I thought it had a chance since they 
answered Urara-senpai, though.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they're on guard? 
There were rumors that it might be a 
Morals Committee crackdown, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“And—Windy-san's flexible mindset born 
from ‘cunning schemes and villainous 
thinking’! 
A creative ingenuity entirely different 
from my own!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—To move a bad guy, you gotta use bad guy 
style, nodda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll come up with a plan that'll make 
those bad guys wanna show their faces, 
nodda! 
Heh-heh-heh, just you wait, you bad guys~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai, did you come up with 
something...!? 
All right, I'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Um, can I write another reply 
to "Pace Reader"-san?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I feel like they replied because they 
wanted to talk to me about something. 
So I really want to keep trying until we 
can talk!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If you keep reaching out, they're 
bound to respond eventually! 
Let's write a reply together again! I'll 
help you!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm... Hearing that they come here after 
losing made you itch to do something, 
right? 
Then let's share those feelings with them!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I'll help you think of words that'll get 
through to them! 
Let's do our best and see it through, 
Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want to tell them everything I'm 
feeling right now! 
Thanks, Big-san!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! 
Let's see, "I raced against a Front Runner 
girl too, and"—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ehh, you're really gonna do that!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It'll totally be fine, nodda! 
I understand how bad guys think. 'Cause 
I'm bad too, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see, that makes sense... You're the 
ultimate bad guy, Windy-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even Fenomeno saw potential in my badness, 
nodda! 
That girl, well... she's got a pretty good 
eye for talent, nodda.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're right. The Captain 
acknowledged us and needed us. 
We're gonna live up to her expectations!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheheheh! If I do say so myself, it's a 
flawless plan, nodda♪ 
Now then, let's barge into the pool hall 
where those bad guys hang out—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Windy-san.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Eep!? C-C-Captain!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am no longer your Captain, you know. 
More importantly, I believe I just heard 
you mention barging into a pool hall—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Your ears were playing tricks on you, 
nodda! I didn't say that at all! 
I've totally and completely forgotten 
about investigating the archive room, 
nodda!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? 
...Ah, could you wait for just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Here you go. 
I'm certain this will suit the current 
you.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright Senpai, we're counting on you! 
—Go knock 'em dead, like a true bad guy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, nodda! 
With these clothes from the Captain, no 
one's gonna mess with me, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, all you punks sneaking into the 
archive room!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The archive room belongs to Windy-chan 
now, nodda! 
I've set lo~ts of traps! If you sneak in, 
you'll fall right into them, nodda♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you want to use the room, come to the 
archive room this weekend! 
Pass the word along to anyone who isn't 
here right now, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Record Board
text_block_list.text:
Huh? 
Oh... It's probably just those Morals 
Committee members who've been sniffing 
around lately or something.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? Like the Morals Committee would 
ever use traps, nodda. 
...Ah, I get it! You're making excuses so 
you can run away, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Running away is totally pathetic, nodda! 
Look at you, scaredy-cat~! 
Cowards don't have the right to call 
themselves bad guys, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you're real bad guys, break through and 
prove it like bad guys should, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you don't show up, the storage room 
belongs to Windy-chan! 
I'll never let you guys use it again! 
Wahahahaha!
